'''James Forinash''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 Seattle tournament]] on 12 August 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base Squassin]], according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1116">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-13-seattle-wa-8-12-00d1116/ seattle-wa-8-12-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 13 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-13-seattle-wa-8-12-00d1116/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
